description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension and a rear roof extension with juliette balcony
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A0288-100 (Rev. 1); A0288-200 (Rev. 01); A0288-110 (Rev. 01); Block/Site Plan (Unreferenced); Site Location Plan (Unreferenced)  Received:  22 January 2019 and A0288-210 (Rev 3); A0288-110 (Rev. 2)  Received:  27 February 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the single storey rear infill extension or the rear roof extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
